headline: Montevallo outscore every other programme in the division
dek: Montevallo have scored 72 goals, and the nearest total in the division belongs to North Georgia of the Peach Belt. The Gulf South side have won seventeen matches, drawn two and lost two.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
